title: Ashbury Rewards Member Tenure Recognition: Elite Bonus Tenure Add-On
content:
| Whole calendar months enrolled in Ashbury Rewards by the handling date | Tenure add-on to the elite bonus percentage |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 10 percentage points |
| 36 to 119 | 5 percentage points |
| Fewer than 36 | None |

**Schedule note.** The tenure add-on is ten points for a member enrolled for at least one hundred and twenty whole calendar months by the handling date, five points for a member enrolled for thirty-six to one hundred and nineteen whole months, and nothing for a member enrolled for fewer months. It is added, in percentage points, to the elite bonus percentage of the member's tier for the elite bonus of a completed stay. The elite bonus percentage with its add-ons is never more than 100 percent. The months are whole calendar months from the enrolment date on the membership to the handling date.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical handling date of 1 December 2026).**

| Enrolment date | Whole months | Tenure add-on |
|---|---|---|
| 2 December 2023 | 35 | None |
| 1 December 2023 | 36 | 5 percentage points |
| 2 December 2016 | 119 | 5 percentage points |
| 1 December 2016 | 120 | 10 percentage points |
